items.title: Wendy's (WEN) Franchise Strains and Dividend Cut Could Be A Game Changer For Investors
items.summary: In mid-September, The Wendy's Company introduced Lisa Barlow's Baby Gorgeous Meal as a limited-time, app- and DoorDash-exclusive offer, bundled with a sweepstakes and Bravo Fan Fest activation to tap into Real Housewives fandom. Around the same time, one of Wendy's largest franchisees, Meritage Hospitality Group, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and Wendy's cut its dividend, underscoring pressure across the franchise system and the company's need to conserve cash. items.title: Lowe's Companies (LOW) Starts 20 Minute Drone Delivery Pilot
items.summary: Lowe's Companies (NYSE:LOW) has begun a drone delivery pilot for home improvement products with Wing and DoorDash in Matthews, N.C. The trial offers select DIY and Pro items delivered to customers from the Matthews store in as little as 20 minutes. Wing manages the drone operations, while DoorDash integrates the new option into its app for same day fulfillment of eligible orders. The new Lowe's drone delivery pilot with Wing and DoorDash is part of broader changes in its digital logistics...

items.title: Uber Has Disappointed For More Than a Year: Here’s Why a Highly Respected Wall Street Firm Says It’s Going to Double
items.summary: Uber's stock has shed nearly 30% over the past year while its cash flow crossed $10 billion and analysts keep raising their targets. One highly respected Wall Street firm sees a path to doubling from here, and the reasoning goes well beyond the rideshare business you think you know.
